run_my_app: run the Hydra-configured my_app that logs its process ID and executes the configured task
review_my_app: review the my_app function decorated with @hydra.main to understand its Hydra configuration setup
summarize_my_app: summarize the my_app function that logs process ID and task name then sleeps for one second
refactor_my_app: refactor the my_app function to replace time.sleep with actual task execution logic
test_my_app: test the my_app Hydra application to verify it logs the correct process ID and task configuration
